notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
You now have unlimited retries per area; you will not be taken back to Area 1 after dying twice. I realized this was unfair to most players, therefore this change should allow a higher number of players to beat the game.

Fixed these achievements:
- 1st Encounter: Don't touch the screen borders in Area 4
- Humans: Kill all Popcorns in Area 4

And an issue with the background music's volume ignoring the value set in Options upon area restart.

I suggest you play the game in windowed since fullscreen mode introduces some issues, notably Steam Overlay glitching and in some cases the game appearing off-center.

Lastly, if you enjoyed the game or have anything to say about it, leaving a review is much appreciated! I read them all, and while I can't guarantee to work all the feedback into the game, I keep note of many points for my future projects.
